Topics. technical SEO / correcting Shopify’s default URL structure (removing the collection path from product URLs), managing product/blog tag indexing, utilizing custom robots.txt, handling product variants (merging vs. canonical tags), redirecting deleted products, and implementing structured data (schema); site speed / choosing lightweight themes, optimizing image formats (WebP) and sizes, implementing lazy loading, async/deferring non-essential scripts, and minifying code; keyword research / building topical maps using tools like Semrush and Keyword Cupid, prioritizing bottom-of-funnel pages via Google Search Console impressions, conducting keyword gap analysis, and matching search intent; site structure / optimizing main menus, featuring high-volume collections on the homepage, utilizing faceted navigation (with caution), and implementing breadcrumbs and related product links; on-page SEO / optimizing key elements (Title, H1, URL) for collection and product pages, adding detailed descriptions (splitting descriptions above and below grids), incorporating FAQ accordions, and leveraging rich snippets; content strategy / building topical authority through comprehensive blog content, internally linking to shopping pages, and embedding product CTAs; link building / building foundational links (citations, social profiles), executing guest posts and niche edits (prospecting, outreach, negotiation), and utilizing platforms like HARO/Connectively for PR and media backlinks.

The URL Structure Fix: Editing the Shopify theme code (specifically the product grid snippet) to remove the within collection parameter, ensuring product URLs always point to the primary /products/product-name path rather than creating duplicate URLs with the collection path.

Topical Mapping: Building out comprehensive content covering all subtopics related to a main keyword to establish the site as an authority, enabling it to outrank larger, broader competitors like Amazon.

The "One Topic Per Page" Rule: Ensuring that no two pages on the site target the exact same keyword (keyword cannibalization), assigning distinct topics to collections, products, and blog posts based on search intent.

Guest Posting Strategy: The specific process for scraping a competitor's backlink profile using Semrush, filtering for domains with >1,000 monthly visits, and executing cold email outreach to secure contextual links.
Skip. Plugs for the agency's done-for-you services or the School community.
Scope mix. 10% baseline (basic Shopify navigation), 90% growth (advanced technical SEO, link building strategies). Volume. ~450 words.
